_comment: Machine-local overrides. Gitignored — never committed, never inherited by a project copied from this template.
_comment_supervisor: Grants this machine the right to launch the unattended supervisor, which spawns claude sessions in a self-restarting loop. Deliberately NOT in .claude/settings.json: that file ships with the template, and a template that pre-grants every downstream project the right to auto-launch an unbounded loop of agents is a bad default. On the dedicated server, add the same two lines to that machine's settings.local.json — see .claude/unattended/README.md.
_comment_session_writes: Ratified by the owner 2026-08-27. Grants a supervisor-spawned session the right to repair the harness it runs on. WITHOUT this, an overnight run can diagnose but not fix: session S3 found and proved four real hook defects and could only stage a patch and park. Deliberately NARROW - three directories, not all of .claude/ - and paired with an explicit deny below, because the thing being widened is the agent's access to its own guardrails. Machine-local on purpose: settings.json ships with the template and must not pre-grant this to every downstream project.
